chk_attachment_single_owner.name: chk_attachment_single_owner
chk_attachment_single_owner.value: ("attachments"."employee_id" is not null and "attachments"."leave_request_id" is null) or ("attachments"."employee_id" is null and "attachments"."leave_request_id" is not null)

chk_employee_identity.name: chk_employee_identity
chk_employee_identity.value: "employees"."national_id" is not null or "employees"."passport_id" is not null

chk_overtime_value_by_type.name: chk_overtime_value_by_type
chk_overtime_value_by_type.value: ("overtime_records"."overtime_type" = 'hourly' and "overtime_records"."hours" > 0 and "overtime_records"."day_units" is null) or ("overtime_records"."overtime_type" in ('rest_day','public_holiday') and "overtime_records"."day_units" > 0 and "overtime_records"."day_units" <= 1 and "overtime_records"."hours" is null)

chk_clock_order.name: chk_clock_order
chk_clock_order.value: "work_day_records"."clock_out_at" is null or "work_day_records"."clock_in_at" is null or "work_day_records"."clock_out_at" >= "work_day_records"."clock_in_at"
